title: Refund Cover Added to Northloop Payments Card Settlements
content:
**Rule.** A seller-authorised card settlement of a negative Northloop Payments balance carries a refund cover. The refund cover is 0.25 times the seller-funded refund debits of the refund window when those refund debits are positive and at least 10 percent of the sale credits of the same window, 0.10 times them when they are positive and at least 5 percent but below 10 percent, and nothing otherwise; the refund cover is rounded to the cent. It is added unchanged to the settlement basis as topped up, and the card settlement amount so obtained is rounded to the cent.

## Cover by refund level

| Seller-funded refund debits of the refund window | Refund cover |
|---|---|
| positive and at least 10% (0.10) of the window's sale credits | 0.25 times the refund debits |
| positive and at least 5% (0.05) but below 10% of the window's sale credits | 0.10 times the refund debits |
| any other case, including no refund debits | nothing |

## Hypothetical boundary cases (window sale credits 15000.00 USD)

- Refund debits 1500.00 USD: exactly 10 percent, cover 0.25 times 1500.00, that is 375.00 USD.
- Refund debits 1200.00 USD: 8 percent, cover 120.00 USD.
- Refund debits 750.00 USD: exactly 5 percent, cover 75.00 USD.
- Refund debits 700.00 USD: below 5 percent, no cover.
